notes.title: Sweatness and light: The Men of Yoshiwara: Kikuya review
notes.notes:
Join Ella McConnell for Waifu Material, a new monthly column in which she navigates the murky, cherry-blossom-strewn waters of visual novels, dating sims, and everything in between (reader masochism not required but strongly recommended). [Content warning: sketchy consent stuff.]

With one of my most recent visual novel excursions having been the cat-fucking creepiness of NEKOPARA, it was high time to go back into otome territory.The Men of Yoshiwara: Kikuya was released on Steam back in October 2015, with the game previously having been available on the PS Vita and as a smartphone app. Because of the latter and the fact that it costs a whopping 22.99 at full price, I had my doubts BUT IT S TOO LATE NOW. (more…)

notes.title: June 7th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10481324/0815db7219585a60c07c5f9f37163225d282956c.jpg[/img]

Updates:
- Add functionality to the settings.

Fast Forward(SKIP) : Read sentences/All sentences
Full-screen mode : Standard/Light

*To use the new function ("Read sentences" on "Fast Forward(SKIP)") , you need to read sentences that you would like to skip.

----------
6月7日　更新情報

「設定」に機能を追加しました。

早送り ： 「既読のみ」「未読含む」で選択可能に
フルスクリーン ： 「標準（画質優先）」「軽量（速度優先）」で選択可能に

※早送りの「既読/未読」判定について、バージョンアップ直後は全て「未読」状態になっています。予めご了承下さい。
